description: Searches Federal Register documents via the official API (public domain). Filter by terms, agency slug, document type (rule, proposed rule, notice, presidential document) and date range. Each result includes title, document number, type, agencies, publication date, effective date, comment end date, abstract, and PDF/HTML URLs. `limit` max 50. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
